head: codex/5727-csdlc-claim-reacquire
title: [v0.91.8][csdlc-v2][claims] Make released bound claims safely reacquirable
body:
## Outcome

Adds a typed `csdlc-bind --reacquire-request` path for deliberately released or expired nonterminal claims without lifecycle rewind.

## Safety

- compare-and-swap generation and digest guards
- actual branch/worktree validation
- one Git-common lock and cross-worktree live-claim inventory
- shared exclusion for init, bind, scope amendment/transition, reacquisition, and expired recovery
- dormant doctor classification without weakening mutation claim checks

## Proof

- Gate 2: 52/52
- Gate 7 lifecycle: 37/37
- clippy: pass
- fmt: pass
- real #5354 dormant bound record reacquired with phase and audit history preserved; new doctor reports pass
- independent exact-head review: no actionable findings

Closes #5727
